conceptProposals.label: Airplane
conceptProposals.definition: A fixed-wing aircraft, not the action of flying.

conceptProposals.label: Bridge
conceptProposals.definition: A physical structure crossing an obstacle.

conceptProposals.label: Travel
conceptProposals.definition: Travel between places; not every directional or inflected realization.

conceptProposals.label: Vacation
conceptProposals.definition: A vacation or holiday break from usual activity.

conceptProposals.label: Ticket
conceptProposals.definition: An admission or travel ticket; not a legal citation.

conceptProposals.label: Bowl
conceptProposals.definition: A bowl used as a container.

conceptProposals.label: Cup
conceptProposals.definition: A cup used for drinking; not a measurement or trophy.

conceptProposals.label: Waiter
conceptProposals.definition: A restaurant server; not the verb wait.

conceptProposals.label: Science
conceptProposals.definition: Science as a field of study.

conceptProposals.label: Email
conceptProposals.definition: An email message or electronic-mail communication; source realization requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Internet
conceptProposals.definition: The Internet as a computer network.

conceptProposals.label: Send
conceptProposals.definition: Send something; participants and direction are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Share
conceptProposals.definition: Share something with others; participants need contextual review.

conceptProposals.label: Telephone
conceptProposals.definition: A telephone device or telephone communication; exact source sense needs review.

conceptProposals.label: Together
conceptProposals.definition: Together or jointly, without asserting a sentence construction.

conceptProposals.label: Blanket
conceptProposals.definition: A blanket used as a cover.

conceptProposals.label: Glasses
conceptProposals.definition: Eyeglasses worn for vision; not drinking glasses.

conceptProposals.label: Hat
conceptProposals.definition: A hat worn on the head.

conceptProposals.label: Key
conceptProposals.definition: A physical key for a lock; not a keyboard or musical key.

conceptProposals.label: Napkin
conceptProposals.definition: A napkin used at a table.

conceptProposals.label: Sofa
conceptProposals.definition: A sofa or couch used for seating.

conceptProposals.label: Stairs
conceptProposals.definition: A set of stairs in a building.

conceptProposals.label: Animal
conceptProposals.definition: An animal in the ordinary nonhuman sense.

conceptProposals.label: Duck
conceptProposals.definition: A duck as an animal, not lowering the head.

conceptProposals.label: River
conceptProposals.definition: A river or watercourse; not a financial bank.

conceptProposals.label: Star
conceptProposals.definition: A star in the sky; not a famous person.

conceptProposals.label: Birthday
conceptProposals.definition: A birthday or anniversary of birth.
